_comment: SPIDER v3.0 config — single-leg patient anchor sniper. Producer reads wallet/strategyId/chatId/minScore from here. Runtime owns position tracking, daily caps, cooldowns, and drawdown gates via runtime.yaml's risk.guard_rails block.
_thesis: Spider v3.0 — patient long-anchor sniper. Holds one anchor for 7+ days, scored on arena alignment + SM consensus + funding favorability + 30d relative strength. v3.0 redesign drops the basket leg from v2.0 because the runtime doesn't implement the portfolio-level scanner/action types. Anchor-only: patience without the portfolio complexity.
